notes.title: HELL IS US – New Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
The Hell is Us demo is back! It will be available at 3 PM CEST / 6 AM PT.


Months after its first appearance, the demo returns — now enhanced with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and refined gameplay to make your return to Hadea even smoother. Here’s what’s changed since the last time you played:

 
🎥 New Camera Options
Camera Follow toggle on/off.

Movement Lag and Rotation Lag adjustments for smoother control.
📦 New Inventory Organisation
Added Favorites and Archives tabs for quicker access to your items.
⚙️ New Difficulty Screen
Choose your preferred difficulty level more easily.
📟 Optimisation
Graphics improvements — now playable in 4K at 60 FPS, among other enhancements.
📸 Photo Mode Added
Capture your most stunning moments directly in-game.
🌍 Added Localisations
French voice-over now available.

Text language support for Chinese and Japanese.
🗡️ Parry & Riposte Tweaks
While all attacks can be blocked, only certain attacks can now be parried, triggering a counter-attack.

Added a visual cue for parryable attacks.

New dedicated tutorial.

Riposte camera sequence now only plays once every 5 to 10 ripostes.
🎯 Lock-On / Targeting Tweaks
Added up/down switching when enemies, at the centre of the screen, are in front of one another.

Smoother camera movement.
📟 Miscellaneous
Datapad full boot screen only shows the first time you open it.

Multiple bug fixes.

Various optimisations for better performance.

 

Whether you played the first demo or are discovering Hell is Us for the very first time, now’s the perfect moment to jump back in and see what’s new.
We look forward to hearing your feedback — see you in Hadea.

notes.title: Community Update #3
notes.content:
Looking Back on the Demo 
First of all, we want to give a huge thank you to the Hell is Us community! 

After 5 years of development, it was truly special to finally see our game— even if just a small slice of it— in the hands of players. Excitement was at its peak within the walls of Rogue Factor: seeing the first online reactions, watching streamers and their audiences enjoy the experience— it reminded us why we do what we do! 


[previewyoutube="zluAsOZj5KY;full"][/previewyoutube]
Thanks to you—players and content creators—Hell is Us made it into the Top 50 most played demos during Steam Next Fest! 

Many of you played, and many of you shared your feedback with us, whether here on Steam, on our Discord server, or elsewhere. 

We hear you, and we’re taking your comments seriously as we continue to improve the Hell is Us experience leading up to launch. 

Now, you’re part of the journey as we enter the final sprint toward September 4th, when you’ll be able to continue Rémi’s odyssey on PC, PS5, or Xbox Series. 


Hell is Us is GOLD 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/ac95f56625e1f1f61781ea4a51a7ffa6736e916f.png"]

We’re also excited to announce that Hell is Us has gone GOLD! This means all technical certifications have been passed on consoles. Essentially, version 1.0 of the game is complete. It’s a major milestone for the team, and we’re incredibly proud! 


Looking Back on the Through the Lens of War Event 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/45e5f512d6dd7333bf2b95e96d7a4fce4b69ecb2.jpg"]
Many of you took part in our Through the Lens of War gaming photography event, and we were blown away by the results. In addition to the announced winners, we also shared some of our favorite screenshots

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1620730/view/578263105990038951?l=english"][/dynamiclink]
Report from Hadea Event 
Not into gaming photography? Prefer to express your creativity through writing? You have until the end of the day to take part in the Report from Hadea event. \[Click here] to learn how to participate and what you can win. 

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1620730/view/515213885413786779?l=english"][/dynamiclink]
What’s Next? 
A lot of you are asking: Where’s the console demo? 

No, we haven’t forgotten about console players. In fact, the team is working hard on it right now. We can’t promise or announce anything just yet—stay tuned! 

 

That’s all for now, Hadeans. See you next month!

notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/1f723e6a1c29951e1435594771c14aeb03dec8fe.jpg"]

Hello, community!

In our first community update, we gave you a summary of everything that had been publicly released about Hell is Us over the past year.

Now that we’re approaching the release date of September 4, 2025 (just three months away!), communications are ramping up, and you’ll be hearing more and more about Hell is Us—whether on our Discord, social media, in the press, or through content creators.
Hell is Us Press Tour
May was a big month for us in terms of meeting with the press and content creators during our North American and European press tours.

The North American tour took place at our Rogue Factor offices in the Mile-End district of Montreal. Representatives from both international and local media, as well as content creators, responded to our invitation for a hands-on experience with Hell is Us!

We could tell you more, but here’s a video that captures the energy of the event:

Hell is Us Press Tour - Rogue Factor, Montréal, Québec


[previewyoutube="OFb1dLGmJK8;full"][/previewyoutube]


No time to rest! We then packed our bags and headed to Bigben Week in Paris, France, where European media and content creators got their turn to discover Hell is Us.

At this event, our Creative Director and Art Director, Jonathan Jacques Belletête took the time to answer your questions posted on X :

Hell is Us (@HELLisUSgame) / X
What did they think of the game?

"Hell is Us is my most anticipated game for the rest of the year" - Greg Miller from Kinda Funny Games.

“Hell is Us is a promising confluence of ideas. I enjoy the blend of Zelda-like dungeons, Elden Ring’s sense of discovery, and detective-style investigations and puzzle-solving. (...) Rogue Factor has carefully shaved opaqueness from its intentionally challenging puzzle design. This makes even the simplest problem-solving feel more rewarding.” - Marcus Stewart from Game Informer

notes.title: Meet the main character | Remi
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/c459c1f83ed3956794c087bfa55a9f4967ce270c.jpg

Remi’s return was never meant to be triumphant. His homeland is a fractured, haunted place—one that never truly let him go. And something lingers in the ruins, waiting.

He was only five years old when his mother smuggled him out of Hadea, a nation closed off from the world. No one was allowed in or out. But she made a choice—one that condemned her son to a life of questions. He understands why she did it. He knows she wanted him to have a better life, beyond the suffocating isolation of Hadea. But that knowledge does nothing to quiet the trauma of having been left behind.
He does not seek justice. He does not seek redemption. He seeks them. The parents who abandoned him. The nation that erased him. He needs to confront them.
Now, decades later, he has finally found his way back.

A Man Defined by What’s Missing

Remi grew up in Canada’s foster system, raised by strangers in a land that never truly felt like his own. All he carried from his past were the name of his birthplace—Jova—and the fact that his father was the village blacksmith. That, and a strange necklace he’s always kept with him.

When Remi joined the ON Peacekeeping Forces, it wasn’t out of duty, but as a means to an end. When Hadea plunged into civil war, he saw an opportunity—a chance to cross the border under the guise of a humanitarian mission. As the operation was being shut down, he deserted his post to slip into the country before the window closed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/4a80e07d2a307b3bb12aa04130192ff3a6f250fc.png

The land he once belonged to should have been war-torn, divided by conflict. But what he finds is something far worse—something that defies all logic. The civil war he expected has been swallowed by a force he cannot explain. Each step he takes uncovers fragments of a past he was once part of — pieces of a story he was not aware of, now staring back at him through the wreckage. But understanding what happened here comes at a cost, and the deeper he digs, the more he realizes that the truth may be far more terrifying than he ever imagined. Yet, he cannot turn back—he has spent his entire life chasing it.

A World That Demands More Than Survival

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/0770dd6a51cd46f1363e5d188794979d9bd644cf.png

The world of Hell is Us is not just a backdrop—it is a test. There are no clear answers, no simple threats, only the brutal demand to adapt or perish.
Remi’s only tools are a set of mysterious weapons—whose origin is as enigmatic as the forces he must face—a resourceful drone named KAPI, and a datapad. They’ll prove useful, but the answers he’s looking for… he’ll have to find on his own.

The Weight of Isolation

Remi won’t be handed the answers he seeks. If he wants to understand what happened here, he’ll have to search for clues—scattered across the land, buried in ruins, and hinted at in the words and actions of those he meets. Some may help him, but no one will offer up the truth for free. In these troubled times, everyone has their own burdens, and their willingness to assist may depend on what he can do for them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/52932bf2441722c8373be7f5b22822966b701237.png

You must read the world itself—follow the remnants left behind by those who came before, listen for the unnatural silence that signals danger, and decide whether to push forward or turn back. Every discovery is earned, and every mistake is yours alone.
Remi’s journey isn’t just about surviving what lies ahead—it’s about confronting what’s always been missing. The civil war may have reshaped Hadea, but for him, the real wound was inflicted long before the conflict began.

What if the truth he’s been seeking is worse than not knowing?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/996d0ab79c53ebe64d7d3f44c7d58e4057849e72.png
 
We’ve only scratched the surface of Remi’s journey. In the coming months, we will reveal more about his past, the dangers he will face, and the choices that will define him.
But in a world where the truth has been buried under centuries of silence, will understanding be enough?

Follow us on our Social Medias and prepare for what lies ahead. The answers are coming—but so is something else.
DISCORD X FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM

notes.title: ⚠️ Known technical Issue with some Intel CPUs
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

As we gear up for the Hell is Us demo  (June 2–16), we want to inform you about a technical issue that may affect a small number of players using Intel 13th and 14th Gen CPUs.

🧠 In brief, what’s the Issue?

Some recent Intel CPUs (13th and 14th Gen) are experiencing random crashes in games built with Unreal Engine 5, like Hell is Us. The root cause is a hardware instability known as “Vmin Shift”, triggered by high voltage and heat due to overly aggressive motherboard settings.

Intel has identified the issue and is rolling out a BIOS microcode update (version 0x12B) to fix it. However, this update depends on motherboard manufacturers, so it may not yet be available for all systems.

👉 Official Intel resource: Intel Community – Vmin Shift Instability

🎮 Other Major Games Affected

This issue isn’t unique to Hell is Us. Several high-profile games have reported similar problems:

 Remnant 2
 Path of Titans
 Warhammer 40,000: Darktide
 Star Wars Jedi: Survivor
 Dragonkin : The Banished
 Lords of the Fallen
 Black Myth : Wukong

Some studios have even added in-game warnings for players using these CPUs.

🛠️ What Can You Do?
[olist]
 Update your BIOS to the latest version from your motherboard manufacturer.
 Enable “Intel Baseline” settings in the BIOS if available.
 If you're not comfortable with BIOS updates, we recommend contacting a local technician or your motherboard’s support team.
 Update the CPU microcode using Intel XTU : https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/download/17881/intel-extreme-tuning-utility-intel-xtu.html
[/olist]
📢 Support During the Demo
If you encounter issues during the Steam Next Fest demo, here’s how to reach us:


 Nacon Support: https://my.nacongaming.com/en-US/support
 Official Discord: Use the #bugs-report and #feedback channels
 Steam: Check the “Known Issues” section on the demo page
 Intel Support: https://www.intel.com/content/www/us/en/support.html


Thanks to everyone who has helped us identify and troubleshoot these issues. Your feedback is invaluable in making Hell is Us the best experience possible.

🔥 See you in Hadea,
The Hell is Us Team

notes.title: A Closer Look at Ultra Settings and 4K Performance in Hell is Us
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/5ad6e483eb9cc63a2dca13909b837627d6b8bd3a.jpg

Hey everyone,

Following the recent reveal of the PC specifications for Hell is Us, we've seen a lot of passionate discussion—especially around the mention of 30 FPS in 4K with a RTX 4090 GPU when using Ultra settings. 

Link to PC Specs news :
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1620730/view/515211349279638277?l=english
 
We’d like to take a moment to clarify what that actually means, and why there’s more to the story than that single number.
 
Understanding Our Graphics Presets
The performance estimates we provided are based on very conservative benchmarks. Our Ultra settings aim to push visual fidelity as far as possible—and we do mean ultra.
Here's how our built-in upscaling is configured across each preset:

Low: 50% 
Medium: 40%
High: 30%
Very High: 20%
Ultra: 10%

By default, the game uses Unreal Engine’s Temporal Super Resolution (TSR) for upscaling, but we also support DLSS, XeSS, and FSR—all of which will be fully updated to their latest versions at launch in September.
 
So... 30 FPS on a 4090?
With Ultra settings, we prioritize visual fidelity over framerate. That said, the RTX 4090 will run Hell is Us at higher than 30 FPS in 4K Ultra—but it may not consistently reach 60 FPS. We’re simply being realistic in our communication to avoid overpromising. Our goal is to set clear expectations, not to limit what your system can achieve.
Remember, you’re always free to tune the settings to find the balance that’s right for you. Ultra is just the upper ceiling.
 
Try It for Yourself
Don’t let this hold you back from giving the demo a try during the upcoming Steam Next Fest. You’ll be able to test the game directly and get a feel for how it performs on your own system. Every PC is different, and real-world performance can often surprise you.
Thanks again for your feedback and support—we love seeing the community so engaged, and we’re excited for you to dive into the world of Hell is Us.
 
See you soon,
The Hell is Us Team

notes.title: Hell is Us | PC SPECS
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/4ec594f36133e6625f2654cf965529c19518160a.png

You’re about to step into Hadea… but is your PC ready for the journey?

You shall leave this news with the answer!

A Quick Note on the Steam Page

If you previously checked the specs listed on our Steam page, you might have seen requirements that looked a bit high. That was intentional — we preferred to set the bar high at first to avoid disappointment. But good news: the specs are now fully up to date, and you can safely refer to them there.

Now, let’s break things down in more detail:

🟢 Minimum Specs

These are the specs you'll need to run Hell is Us at a basic level, while still enjoying a smooth and stable experience. You won’t be playing with all the visual bells and whistles, but the game will still look solid — like this:

Graphic Settings: 1080P 30 FPS AVG Medium Setting
GPU: NVIDIA GTX 1070 8GB or AMD RX 5600 XT 6GB
CPU: Intel i7-7700K or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
RAM: 16GB
OS: Windows 10 - 64bit
STORAGE: 30GB SSD

Note: You might have noticed that we listed "medium" settings in the "minimum" configuration. We could have gone with more modest settings. While it is playable on lower-end setups, we decided this configuration represents the minimum required to experience Hell is Us with decent graphics.
________________________________________

🟡 Recommended Specs

This setup is what we consider the ideal balance — similar to what you’d experience on console: smooth gameplay, good graphics, and minimal limitations.

Graphic Settings: 1080P 60 FPS AVG High Settings
GPU: "NVIDIA RTX 2080Ti 11GB or AMD RX 6750 XT 12GB
CPU: Intel i7-11700K or AMD Ryzen 5 7600
RAM: 16GB
OS: Windows 10 - 64bit
STORAGE: 30GB SSD

________________________________________

🔴 Ultra Specs

Want to see Hell is Us in all its glory? These are the specs you’ll need to maximize performance and visual fidelity — with every slider pushed to the limit.

Graphic Settings: 4K 30 FPS AVG Ultra Settings
GPU: NVIDIA RTX 4090, 24 GB or AMD RX 7900 XTX 24GB
CPU: Intel i7-11700K or AMD Ryzen 5 7600
RAM: 16GB
OS: Windows 10 - 64bit
STORAGE: 30GB SSD

________________________________________

Additionally, we’ve thrown in other setting ideas — High and Very High — as we know there are many possibilities and we can’t cover every setup in a single news post. But hopefully, it gives you a good idea of where you stand and what you need to play Hell is Us.

Whatever your setup, we hope you’ll be able to enjoy Hell is Us the way that suits you best. In the meantime, get your rig ready. Hadea awaits.

notes.title: Hell is Us | Demo Available June 2–16
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We’re about to take the biggest step yet for Hell is Us.

After introducing the game’s concept, themes, and a first glimpse of gameplay, it’s finally time for the ultimate test: letting you play it.

From June 2 to June 16, Hell is Us will be playable via a demo on Steam.

🎮 A quick word for our console players:

We know many of you are eagerly awaiting the game, and we would have loved to offer the demo on consoles as well. Unfortunately, due to technical constraints, this isn’t currently possible — it’s simply much easier to release a demo on PC.
Please rest assured: Hell is Us will launch simultaneously on PC and consoles, with the same content and the same level of polish. Development is progressing equally across all platforms — this limitation only concerns the demo.

📖 What does the demo cover?

The demo begins right at the start of the game.
You’ll step into Rémi’s shoes, armed with only the limited information he has, and begin your descent into Hadea.
This introduction is meant to ease you into Hell is Us and its core gameplay systems.
It won’t show you everything the full game has to offer — it’s just the beginning.
Some of the key elements, like exploration and the player plattering experience, truly come into their own as the world opens up and the layers unfold.

🔧 The game is still in development

The full release is set for September 4, nearly three months after the demo goes live.
While the demo represents a solid slice of the game, some features and content will only be available in the final version.

🗣️ Localisation:

The demo will be available in English only, including full English voice acting.
The full game will support the following languages:

Voice acting
English, French

Text & Subtitles
English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified), Russian, Polish, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Turkish.

⚔️ Difficulty Options

Hell is Us is not designed to be an easy game — but it is designed to be accessible.
The demo includes three difficulty levels as well as several customization options to tailor the experience to your play style.
We encourage you to experiment and find the setting that feels right.


💻 PC Specs

If you checked the system requirements earlier on Steam, you might have noticed they seemed a bit high. That’s because we hadn’t completed our full optimization tests yet.
We’ve now finalized the specs, and you can find the updated requirements on our Steam page.
Additionally, we’ll put together a dedicated news post with more details very shortly.


💬 We want your Feedback

This demo is our final opportunity to gather your feedback before launch — and we’ll be paying close attention.
You can share your impressions in the Steam Discussions, on social media, or directly on Discord, where we’ll be actively engaging with the community.
We’re also setting up dedicated channels for demo feedback, so don’t hesitate to jump in.

Join our Discord ➡️ DISCORD

👁️ The rest is yours to discover.

It wouldn’t be Hell is Us if we told you everything, would it?

We hope you enjoy the demo — and we can’t wait to see how you experience the world of Hell is Us.

Follow us on our socials medias to take part in future community events.

notes.title: Hell is Us | Community Update #1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/99a3c756c38f561d01b2078e88156b60bda644b4.jpg

Hi everyone, 

Welcome to the very first Hell is Us Community Update! 

With this new format, we want to take a little time—at least once a month—to talk directly to you, as Rogue Factor, the people behind Hell is Us. Not from Hadea (thankfully), but from Montreal. A much calmer place... most of the time.  

Since this is the first edition, we’ll use the opportunity to go a bit beyond just “last month” and do a quick recap of where we’ve come from so far.  

FROM REVEAL TO TRAILERS

A lot has happened since our first reveal in April 2022. But let’s not rewind that far. Let’s start somewhere exciting: the two State of Play showcases. 

We were lucky enough to be featured in two of Playstation’s biggest events lately: 

First, with our Gameplay Reveal Trailer, where we introduced the world of Hell is Us — its tone, its world, and a few glimpses of what’s hiding beyond the Border. 

And later, with our Release Date Trailer, which focused more on Remi, the complex human at the center of all this. 

Watch the Gameplay Reveal 

[previewyoutube=ynk7LyKGNHM;full][/previewyoutube]

The goal was simple: give you a sense of what Hell is Us is all about — without showing too much. Because this is a game that’s better felt than explained. That said… we also knew you’d want to see more gameplay. 

EXTENDED GAMEPLAY EXPLAINED

So we followed it up with the Extended Gameplay video — a 15-minute walkthrough with our Creative Director and Art Director, Jonathan Jacques-Belletête (that we will call JJB from now on). 

Watch the Extended Gameplay 

[previewyoutube=Q69e1A3ovxI;full][/previewyoutube]

In it, JJB dives deep into a longer sequence that better shows what the game is really like to play — the mood, the pace, the tension, the danger. You responded better than we could’ve hoped, and that gave us even more motivation to keep refining what matters most. 

You also got a first taste of how the game balances two key pillars: Exploration and Combat. In our minds, it’s 50/50 — and the way you navigate between those two will shape your experience. 

Around the same time, we released a blog explaining one of our core philosophies: Player Plattering. 

This one’s close to our hearts. It’s a design idea born from our love for games that lets players figure things out for themselves — games that don’t over-explain, don’t hold your hand, and trust you to create your own meaning. That’s what we’re aiming for with Hell is Us. 

Read the Player Platerring Blog 

INTRODUCING REMI

Then there’s Remi — our protagonist. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/99885b15b16a5b7f22af25466154eaa3a5c495af.jpg

He’s… complicated. And we like him that way. He’s not a savior, not a chosen one, and definitely not invincible. He’s human. And throughout the game, he’ll evolve. 

We introduced Remi more properly in the Release Date Trailer, and announced he’s voiced by the incredible Elias Toufexis — the one and only voice of Adam Jensen in Deus Ex. It was a reunion with JJB (they’ve got history), and honestly? We can’t imagine anyone else in the role. 

You can follow Elias on X: https://x.com/EliasToufexis 
And yes, more content with him is coming soon!

Release Date Trailer

[previewyoutube=8iZbNIAM8eQ;full][/previewyoutube]

We’re also working on a dedicated blog about Remi, so you can get a deeper sense of who he is — and who he isn’t. 

INVESTIGATION AT THE HEART OF THE EXPERIENCE

Most recently, we released the Investigation Trailer, which focused on an essential part of the game: how you make sense of what’s happening around you. 

We’d shown the world. We’d shown combat. But investigation is where the game opens up — where Player-Plattering really shines. 

Naturally, JJB returned for a 7-minute breakdown of how investigation works, how it connects to the world, and how it avoids feeling like a checklist. 

Watch the Investigation Trailer 

[previewyoutube=dH0oJyvku68;full][/previewyoutube]

What’s Next? 

If you’ve been following us, a lot of this might already sound familiar. But we’re not here just to recap the past. Here's a peek at what’s next: 

Two upcoming dev blogs — including the one about Remi. They’ll dive deeper into the world,characters and share some of the thoughts that shaped the project. 

Behind-the-scenes content — meet more members of the Rogue Factor team, see how things have evolved, and get to know the minds behind the game. 

And of course, we'd love you to follow us on our socials (links at the bottom) not only we will continuously share new content, but we love to discuss theories, make some challenges, and some might make you get your hands so some cool stuff, just saying… 

MAY, A BIG MONTH FOR HELL IS US

With some Press and Creators coming to Montreal to have a first experience of Hell is Us, and BigBen Week coming up in Paris in just a week,  we're starting to show the game to more and more people, and things are becoming much more concrete every day.
 
We’re just four months away from release — and things really start to accelerate. 

We couldn’t skip over everything we’ve done so far in this first Community Update, but future editions will focus more on the present: what we’re working on right now, what’s changing, and how the game is shaping up as we head toward launch.  You might even pick up on a few behind-the-scenes secrets along the way.

Thank you again for your continued interest in Hell is Us. Seeing players connect with our vision is what keeps us going every day. 
 
We can’t wait for you to finally get your hands on it. 

Until next time,
— The Hell is Us Team

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/4e4ab9653e764041d5c9a46ab85d67c5944922be.jpg

notes.title: Poll Week | The Path You Chose
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/40689514d0c98b269e78492b6bc3148440ddda19.png

Hadea is strange. And dangerous.

In just a few months, you’ll walk its scorched soil through Rémi’s footsteps. He chose to be there. He has a purpose.

But what if you didn’t choose?

What if you simply woke up… in the wrong place?

That’s the question we asked you last week on X. And here is the story you told.
________________________________________

You awaken in Hadea, with no memory of how you got there. The sky is unfamiliar. The land is barren, but not dead. A civil war burns in the distance. You don’t belong here. And nothing about this place suggests you’re welcome.

Whoever put you here apparently wanted to give you a chance. Before you lies a choice. Four weapons—each pulsing with a light you don’t recognize, forged from a material you’ve never seen. All meant for close combat.

 
 One-handed sword – 40%
  Two-handed sword – 25.5%
  Double axe – 20.6%
  Polearm – 13.2%


You reach for the one-handed sword.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/fd3a3200105f6eb72752924a8f7ee7d002589f04.jpg

Not because it’s the strongest. But because it feels familiar. In a world that defies everything you know, that’s all you can cling to.

This sword is yours now. It may not be the best. It may not even be enough. But it’s yours.
And with it, you walk.
________________________________________

The land grows stranger. No one crosses your path. No sound but the wind.
And then: a gate. Sealed, ancient, whispering.
No lock. No handle. But four pillars surround it—each one humming in rhythm with your blade. Each marked by an emotion.

Your hand hesitates. Rage pulses in your veins. But something in you leans toward something else. Not joy, exactly. But release.


 Ecstasy – 27%
 Rage – 26.5%
 Grief – 24%
 Terror – 22.5%


Ecstasy.

You strike the pillar. The gate opens.
On the ground: a sword—like yours, but changed. Its shape refined, its light glowing golden. You pick it up. You feel it: not just power… but confidence. A dangerous kind. And yet, welcome.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/7202be885150b95eef4fa59d25d0ac1f79fe8dff.jpg
________________________________________

This place… it doesn’t feel like any known age. No culture you’ve learned about. You’re walking through the remains of something not meant for you.
Hadea is ancient. Lost. And you’re alone.
Still, you walk.
In the distance: a grand hall. Four corridors.

Another choice. Another test.

Each path promises something. But each is guarded. Not by man, nor beast—but by creatures you can’t explain. Shapes twisted just enough to be wrong.


 Twister humanoid (43.5%)
 Crawling tailed being (16.3%)
 Brute with wing-like arms 17.7%
 Floating ghostly shape 22.4%


You follow your instinct—and face the most human-looking one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/9fa86817c95ce4c9a8b3cc6d20a43a83765e803f.gif

It’s a brutal fight. But you survive. Just barely.
Any of the others, and you wouldn’t have. You know it.
In Hadea, instinct is the only thing that hasn’t lied to you yet.
________________________________________

Past the corpse of your enemy, a door awaits. This one is… unlocked.
Even here, sometimes luck exists. Or so you think.
Inside: a word etched into the stone wall—Vigil.
It means nothing to you.

On the table: a key. And four locked chests. Each marked with a word:
Strength. Knowledge. Wealth. Escape.
Your final choice.


  Knowledge – 53%
  Strength – 28%
  Escape – 13%
  Wealth – 5.6%


Surprisingly, this was your clearest decision.

You’re not ready to leave. You don’t crave gold. Power means little without understanding.
You choose to know.
The key turns—but remains stuck in place., sealed, not to be used again.
 
The lid opens.

Inside, a single document:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/b4a7a8c5d4e57bda13f91df40208656faf928fba.png

What is Jova? No matter what is it, that is your next destination.
________________________________________

You are the first to arrive here in a very long time.

But maybe—just maybe—someone else, coming from outside, looking for answers, will follow your footsteps. Maybe you’ll cross paths and together, find the answer you seek.

Welcome to Hadea.

notes.title: Hell is Us | Welcome to Hadea
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/911481ba5113d19aa538b653ca2654f5b1654c93.png

Hadea is not just a country, it is a mystery.

A fractured land where the known and the unknown collide, haunted by the aftermath of civil war. For its inhabitants, it is both home and torment — a place that watches in silence as they struggle to survive its relentless trials.

To understand Hadea is to step into the very heart of Hell is Us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/e2e5a792bb179b7d7a2a3a1291cc2fe856e5d0f4.jpg

The Allure of a Broken Land.

Hadea still pulses with culture and history, its people proud of their homeland. It has always been a harsh place to live, but now, it stands at its lowest — transformed into a realm of desolation and anguish. The skies hang heavy, and the land itself seems to resent those who tread upon it. Yet, even amidst the devastation, Hadea holds a haunting allure. Its remnants of the past offer fleeting glimpses into a forgotten era, while its scarred landscapes invite exploration. From its eerie forests to its silent ruins, Hadea is unlike anywhere else, drawing the curious and the brave to uncover its secrets.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/9cbd55254b538f2b971f9f594e7e5161a1d13da4.jpg

Hadea does not explain itself. Its ruins, forests, and towns hold remnants of lives erased by the civil war and the events that followed. Monuments crumble in silence, their stories left to the imagination. The land is both a puzzle and a reflection of the past.
Each step forces you to confront truths you might rather leave buried, blurring the line between victim and participant. Hadea compels you to grapple with its mysteries and reckon with your own.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/7ab1812e8de3542cb5ab38e76fe2cb1a11c9c7ed.jpg

A Test of Will

Each step shapes your relationship with the land, whether you seek its truths or simply fight to endure its hostility. The entities that roam its terrain are as enigmatic as the world itself.
Facing them is not just a test of strength but a journey into the very essence of this fractured world. And yet, amid the dangers, Hadea’s tragic beauty persists, urging you to explore its depths and marvel at its singularity.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42249540/fffcce1a590baa2f07ae0cf7e7a970b200cd8237.jpg

Hadea’s Legacy

In Hell is Us, Hadea is more than a setting—it is an active force in your journey. Its treacherous terrain and haunting beauty shape every decision you make, testing your resolve at every turn. The land remembers its pain, its history, and its trespassers. It holds answers, but only for those willing to confront its layers of truth and torment. As you uncover its secrets, you may find that understanding Hadea means understanding yourself.

What Lies Ahead

The story of Hadea is far from complete. In the months to come, we will reveal more about its history, its mysteries, and its role in Rémi’s journey. But remember, Hadea does not give up its truths lightly. To walk its paths is to face the unknown—and to marvel at the beauty hidden within its darkness.


Follow us on our socials medias for more updates.
